reason:
Updated UART_DMAReceiveCplt to prevent calling HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback which was causing exceptional loops. The function now:
1. Never calls HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback, even for IDLE reception mode
2. Always calls the standard receive complete callback (HAL_UART_RxCpltCallback or registered equivalent)
3. This is consistent with the changes made to HAL_UART_IRQHandler and UART_Receive_IT
4. All functions now avoid HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback to prevent the exceptional loop
This completes the fix for the exceptional loop issue in HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback.
